baseline: latest resolves to the frozen profile of this same seeded fixture

intents.intent: Every Account must have at least one relationship of any type in either direction. Report an error when this is false.
intents.oracle_query: MATCH (a:Account) WHERE NOT (a)--() RETURN a.id AS id ORDER BY id

intents.intent: An Account may have at most one incoming OWNS relationship from a Customer. Zero owners are allowed by this particular rule. Report an error for multiple owners.
intents.oracle_query: MATCH (a:Account) OPTIONAL MATCH (:Customer)-[r:OWNS]->(a) WITH a, count(r) AS owners WHERE owners > 1 RETURN a.id AS id ORDER BY id

intents.intent: Require an email property on 100% of Customer nodes, including special customers. A breach must be a warning, not an error.
intents.oracle_query: MATCH (c:Customer) RETURN count(c) AS total, count(c.email) AS with_email

intents.intent: All existing Account.balance values must have integer runtime type. Report an error for values of another type.
intents.oracle_query: MATCH (a:Account) WHERE a.balance IS NOT NULL AND NOT a.balance IS :: INTEGER RETURN count(a) AS violations

intents.intent: Each Account.type must belong to the allowed set checking, savings, shell. Report an error for values outside this set.
intents.oracle_query: MATCH (a:Account) WHERE NOT a.type IN ['checking', 'savings', 'shell'] RETURN count(a) AS violations

intents.intent: Account.id must be unique across Account nodes. Report an error for duplicate values.
intents.oracle_query: MATCH (a:Account) WITH a.id AS id, count(*) AS n WHERE n > 1 RETURN id ORDER BY id

intents.intent: Assert that the actual number of Customer nodes is exactly 1500. This is a value regression assertion on the count, including all Customer nodes. Report an error if the actual count differs.

For customer CUST-RING-LEADER-0, the distinct Account IDs reachable by one to four outgoing CONTROLS hops must include ACC-2401 and ACC-2408. Other reachable accounts are allowed. Use a query parameter for the customer ID and compare returned account IDs. Report an error if either required account is missing.
intents.oracle_query: MATCH (:Customer {id: $customer_id})-[:CONTROLS*1..4]->(a:Account) WHERE a.id IN ['ACC-2401', 'ACC-2408'] RETURN DISTINCT a.id AS id ORDER BY id

intents.intent: Every Transaction must have exactly one incoming SENT relationship from an Account. Report an error when this count differs from one.
intents.oracle_query: MATCH (t:Transaction) OPTIONAL MATCH (:Account)-[r:SENT]->(t) WITH t, count(r) AS senders WHERE senders <> 1 RETURN count(t) AS violations

intents.intent: Use a drift check to ensure the number of OWNS relationships has not dropped by more than 10% relative to the supplied latest baseline profile. Report an error if the drop exceeds 10%.
